notes: All 13 unique records from discovery/meta-research.json and diamond/meta-research.json received a complete independent route patch. Outcome: 7 verified_free and 6 needs_verification. No previously uncertain route was promoted from APC-only evidence.

Each route was checked for submission, ordinary publication/APC, page/length, colour, mandatory membership/affiliation, registration and other stated author costs. For verified routes, explicit submission/publication or blanket no-author-cost wording establishes the charge exclusion; silence alone does not. No candidate is a conference.

Research Synthesis Methods is Cambridge wholly OA with a charged ordinary route and assessed conditional support; its prior Wiley hybrid route was not reused. A discount or a waiver request is not a confirmed zero-cost route.

Research Evaluation's current online author guidelines exclude page and colour charges, while its separate Charges page retains author-approved print-colour fees. The apparently legacy print context is an inference and remains documented. Its submission-fee gap independently prevents verified_free.

Accountability in Research author instructions remain blocked with HTTP 403 in both browser and direct HTTP requests; its official indexed no-APC subscription statement is marked search_snippet. Science Editing and European Science Editing ARPHA pages were independently retrieved as complete live policy pages by direct HTTP and are marked page.

Quantitative Science Studies was not added: current MIT submission guidelines returned HTTP 403. The official ISSI update at https://www.issi-society.org/blog/posts/2022/november/open-access-publishing-in-quantitative-science-studies-an-update/ is dated 2022 and explicitly says the earlier subsidy ended after 2022; its expectation of future waivers cannot establish current unconditional free publication.

LIBER Quarterly remains needs_verification because current journal policies expressly exclude APC/publication costs but not submission or all author charges. Meta-Psychology's explicit completely-free journal-wide policy supports both fees; this distinction does not require every policy to repeat every possible charge category.

Scope/review fields are preserved except for source-supported Meta-Psychology preregistration/preprint obligations and Science Editing's invited-review caveat. ESTS's restrictive genAI policy, Research Ethics' mandatory AI statement and European Science Editing disclosure obligations are retained in route conditions.

Official pages were inspected on 2026-11-16. This is independent agent fee verification, not human scientific review, a venue endorsement or a promise of acceptance. Policies should be rechecked close to submission.
